conclusion: Nora Vale (teal coat) entered the lab area at 18:10, took the prototype from the lab, and exited through the east exit at 18:14 carrying the prototype. The visual evidence shows her entering the east corridor with no object (V03), then exiting the east exit with the prototype visible (V04). By 18:18 the prototype was missing from the lab (V05). Her witness statement claiming she only visited the east corridor and left is contradicted by camera evidence showing her carrying the prototype out.
